title: Plugins through an interface
description:
Write text filters behind one interface and chain them.

```
Input: Hello,   World!  hello again
upper      -> HELLO,   WORLD!  HELLO AGAIN
squash     -> Hello, World! hello again
censor     -> Hello,   *****!  hello again
all three  -> HELLO, *****! HELLO AGAIN
```
hints: Extension methods live in a `static class`; `public static ITextFilter Then(this ITextFilter first, ITextFilter next) => new Pipeline(first, next);` (lesson 3.05).
requirements: `interface ITextFilter { string Name { get; } string Apply(string text); }`.
Three filters: upper case, squash repeated spaces, censor a list of words (any case) with `*`.
A `Pipeline` class that runs filters in order and is itself an `ITextFilter`.
An extension method `Then(this ITextFilter first, ITextFilter next)` that builds a pipeline.
stretch: Censor only whole words, so `Worldwide` stays as it is.
